spec.title: AI-Native Lean card H — Local reference models

status.comment: BETA projection; narrower checker scope and WISH gaps are explicit.

p.INTENT: Build an explicit small model with honest abstraction assumptions.

p.APPLICABILITY: The intended subsystem behavior is unclear or an interleaving needs examination.

p.MOTIVATION: A reader should consume an explicit, checkable operation rather than infer a claim from prose or a stale artifact.

p.STRUCTURE: Ordinary Lean model/transition definitions, sample traces and named invariant theorems.

p.SCOPE: The runner can check a supplied model theorem. General automatic exploration, simulation and counterexample extraction are WISH in this version.

p.CONSEQUENCES: Makes the declared boundary reviewable; requires explicit inputs, assumptions and checker time. No broader proof grade follows.

p.ALTERNATIVES: A direct proof may suffice; a finite trace helps find a counterexample but is not a full-world proof.

p.RISKS: A bounded abstraction can hide discovery or environment behavior; update its assumptions before extending its claim. Sunset: revise or retire this card when an accepted checker/representation makes its routine obsolete.

p.EVIDENCE: No package-specific empirical result is claimed. [E-hyp]. This BETA card is grounded in the machine contract spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/lean-ai-native-lang/mechanisms/LEAN-PROOF-RUNNER#root; required runner acceptance cases are at spec://org.vibevm.ai-native/lean-ai-native-lang/mechanisms/LEAN-PROOF-RUNNER#NEGATIVE-CASES. WISH fields identify absent machinery.

band-three.title: Band 3 — Operation
band-three.fence: trigger: WHEN The intended subsystem behavior is unclear or an interleaving needs examination. mode: review routine: 1. Write the independent state and action meanings. 2. Separate observations from hidden environment facts. 3. State abstraction and finiteness assumptions. 4. Construct meaningful sample traces. 5. Check the named theorem. 6. Report only the scope actually checked. checker: lean-ai-native --path . check --carrier lean-proof.toml --subject <fully-qualified-subject>; WISH: automatic exploration raid_role: layer=proof; order=after:independent-contract; batch=theorem budget: active_rules=1; first_signal=one targeted operation within its configured bound
